whyItMatters: Eval.me evaluates strings as groovy code, so untrusted input reaching it becomes code injection.
actions: Replace Eval.me with a typed builder or parser so untrusted input stays data, never code.
If evaluation must stay, isolate it in a sandbox without file, network, or credential access.
Re-run the scan and confirm no Eval.me call remains reachable from untrusted input.
verification: Rescan shows no Eval.me reachable from untrusted input, and injection probes stay inert data.
